$comment: EXP-1560 (was A-16): THE Devices page, one spec ×4 (web my-machines.tsx + device-logins.tsx, desktop machines.rs, iOS AgentsView + DeviceLogins, Android AgentsScreen). LAYOUT: each section (`mine` with its `+ Add device` pill, `team`) is a GRID of device CARDS: columns = max(1, floor((width + card.gap) / (card.minWidth + card.gap))) over the section's content width, gap `card.gap` both ways (a phone in portrait gets 1 column, a phone in landscape or a tablet 2 or more). Groups: online cards first in the list's own order, then the muted `offline` label spanning the grid, then every offline card in its own grid, dimmed (opacity 0.6). CARD = THE GlassCard surface (fill + hairline + radius), padding `card.padding`, two rows. TOP row: left a column of [name (truncates) + `v{version}` beside it (warning tone when the caller's own device is outdated, else muted) + the default star] over [the status line (Online dot / Last seen …) + the `This device` / `Shared` tags]; right the `⋯` overflow (a ghost icon button, `copy.deviceActions`) opening THE Menu. Menu items, in order: the update line (when the device has an `update` / `update_queued` attention item: its `text` as a disabled muted row), `Update` (only when that item's action is `update`; busy while requested), `copy.settings` (own REGISTERED devices; opens the Device settings dialog). A team device's menu holds only a team owner's `copy.removeFromTeam`; a card with no item draws no `⋯` (its slot stays empty). BOTTOM row: the logins as ICONS ONLY, in `sortDeviceLogins` order: each a ghost icon button (`card.iconSize` square) holding the agent's brand mark (`card.markSize`), THE run-mark badge (AgentRunMark `needs_input`: dot top-right, ringed in the card's ground, see THE BADGE) ON every login that has a `login` attention item. With more than `card.maxAccountIcons` logins only the first maxAccountIcons-1 show, then a ghost `⋯` (`copy.moreAccounts`) that reveals the rest in place (`accountIcons`). Own, online cards with an agent to add end the row with a ghost `+` (`copy.addAccount`). A device that reported accounts but holds NO login says `noAccount` muted in the row; one that never reported says `checking`. EXP-1626 PERSIST LOGIN (replaces the EXP-1600 long-lived default and the long-lived Add): every sign-in (Add account, Sign in, the MCP `account_login`) is the agent CLI's normal BROWSER login, which names the account (email), reads every usage window (5h, weekly, per-model) and makes the profile; the sign-in dialog carries no mode line and no mode button. EXP-1627 THE SIGN-IN DIALOG x4: the title is `copy.signInTitle` (never the agent's name), the waiting state is ONE muted line `copy.signInWaiting` ({device} = the device label, {agent} = the agent label) in the body-small size, WRAPPING (never cut off), and the dialog hugs its content (no fixed height, no empty band under the waiting line). THE ACCOUNT PANEL header x4: the email (else label) in the foreground colour at medium weight, the plan muted under it; a usage window's title never truncates (its reset caption gives way first). `copy.persistLogin` is an OPTION on an EXISTING signed-in claude login only (the account panel only): it queues `agent_login {agent: claude, profileId, longLived}` for THAT profile, the same link + code-paste dialog with `copy.persistNote` as its one muted line; the machine runs `claude setup-token` in a fresh staging dir (never inside the profile, so the browser login it holds is never touched) and attaches the one-year token to the profile (`tokenExpiresAt`); nothing is typed or named. Once persisted, the profile's RUNS spend the token, and the browser login's refresh only feeds usage, so the two never rotate each other out. The usage keeps coming from the browser login while it is valid; when its refresh grant dies, the token keeps runs working and the usage falls back to the token's weekly window (the device reports the profile's `usageSource: "token"`). WHICH ONE IS ACTIVE: the panel of a profile with `tokenExpiresAt` shows one muted line under the plan: `copy.persistedToken` when `usageSource` is `token`, else `copy.persistedBrowser`. With a token, the panel offers `copy.renewPersistedLogin` (same queue) instead of `copy.persistLogin`. Codex has no setup-token: neither option. Closing the sign-in dialog before the login lands queues `agent_login_cancel {agent, loginCommandId}`: the machine stops that run (its child is killed and its staging dropped) unless a code was already handed to it; a run nobody finishes is stopped by the machine itself 10 minutes after it started. #EXP-1643 THE ACCOUNT PANEL (replaces the hover card and the account menu: nothing floats any more): a press on an account icon (every platform) expands THAT card: under the icon row a hairline (`card.panelGap` above and below), then the panel, the card grows, its grid row aligns to the top so a neighbour never stretches. The open icon carries the glass-active wash. ONE account open per device; pressing the open icon closes it. Pointer platforms: hovering an icon shows only the platform tooltip with the email (else the label). REMEMBERED per device on this client, never synced: `openDeviceAccount(loginKeys, remembered)` (`accountPanelCases`, every mirror replays them whole): `remembered` absent (never touched this device) or naming a login that is gone = the only login when there is exactly one, else nothing; null (closed by hand) = nothing; a present login = that login. An open login folded behind the `⋯` reveals the folded icons. PANEL, in order: line 1 = the email (else the label) in the foreground at medium weight, flex, truncating, then the icon-only ghost actions (`card.iconSize` buttons, the destructive tone on hover only): `ACTION_SIGN_OUT` (`ui-sign-out`, only when signed in) and `Remove account` (`ui-delete`, always), each named by its tooltip / accessible label and asking its confirm exactly as the menu did; line 2 = the plan muted, flex, then one action pill: `Sign in` (`ui-sign-in`) when signed out or needs_relogin (the browser login), else claude only: `copy.persistLogin` without a token, `copy.renewPersistedLogin` with one (`ui-clock`); no pill otherwise. Then the persisted line (see PERSIST LOGIN) and the login's `status` line in warning tone when it has an attention item, then the usage windows (UsageWindows `full` density: title + reset, then meter + percent: the 5h session, the weeks, the per-model windows, each with its reset; only the windows the login REPORTS: a login whose usage comes from its persisted token reports the weekly window alone, and no empty 5h row is drawn for it). A team device or an offline device of mine expands the same panel with NO actions (no icon buttons, no pill). LEADING ICON: the card's top row leads with the device's own icon (the owner's pick, else the kind default; `deviceIcon`, the same mark the device picker draws) at `card.deviceIconSize`, muted, in a column beside name + status. PHONES: the `⋯` opens THE Menu's bottom sheet, never a popover. ATTENTION (pure, `deviceListRow`): items in order: every login whose health is needs_relogin, then every signed_out login, then every OTHER login with `limitHit` (a fresh usage window at ≥ 100%; text `limitReached`, never an action), (a persisted login is never an item either way: no renewal reminder, no prompt to persist; `copy.renewPersistedLogin` lives in the account panel only), then the update line. A login yields at most one item. An AGENT with no login at all (a CLI installed, never signed in: `profiles` empty or absent) is NOT an item and badges nothing: the old IDE bug where mint read `Signed out` because Codex was installed. The update line exists only on the caller's own device: `updateQueued` when an update is parked behind live sessions (no action), else `updateAvailable` (with `latest`) when the client's own version compare says `outdated` (action `update` only for a SERVER — the CLI daemon is the one device that acts on an update request; a desktop app updates itself — and only while it is online and registered). Login actions (`sign_in`, never on a limit item) only on the caller's own online device. Team devices: read-only (no `+`, no actions), a team owner's Remove in the `⋯`. #EXP-1691 ONE LOOK x4 (web is the reference, all sizes px = pt = sp): THE BADGE: a 6 dot in `semantic.yellow` (#FACC15, web `yellow-400`), its corner 2 past the mark's top-right, a 2 ring wholly OUTSIDE the dot in the opaque card fill (`glass.fillCard` over `palette.card`: web `ring-card-opaque`, iOS `GlassTokens.opaqueCardFill`, Android `GlassTokens.OpaqueCardFill`, desktop `fill_card_opaque`). WARNING TONE on this page (the outdated version, the status line, a usage window's meter at warning): `semantic.yellow`, never Tailwind amber. USAGE WINDOWS, on every surface they draw (the account panel, the session's usage overlay or sheet, the account picker): `full`: title `type.size.xs` (12) regular in the foreground colour, reset caption 11 regular muted, percent `type.size.xs` (12) muted, meter 6 high, title and caption 8 apart, 4 from the title line to the meter, 6 between windows, footnote 11 muted. `mini` and `hover`: every text 10, meter 4 high.
